t: Building a Secure Home Hosting Network with pfSense and Verizon Fios
s: This article details securing home hosting by deploying a dedicated pfSense firewall between an ISP's ONT and router. It emphasizes network segmentation via a DMZ, hardware selection (mini-PCs like Topton), initial pfSense setup, and repurposing ISP routers as access points.
sub: ISP Router Reconfiguration for AP Mode
Hardware Selection for Dedicated Firewall Appliances
